title: WCLAP linked rack
description: A linked rack (SPEC.md §1.1): a wclap-rack v1 document plus a manifest of bundle archives fetched by URL and pinned by the sha256 of their module.wasm. Every bundle the rack uses must have an entry; a linked rack's source carries no files in version 1. Other top-level members (a credit, the rack's page) are allowed and ignored by hosts.

url.description: URL of the bundle archive (.wclap.tar.gz), absolute or relative to the linked document's own URL

sha256.description: sha256 hex of the module.wasm inside the archive
